Definition: this place (French ici), i.e. here or hence
BiblicalUsage: Poh means here, in this place. Elijah stood here on the mountain and heard the still small voice in 1 Kings 19:9, and God told Job, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further, in Job 38:11. Ruth was told to come and sit here in Ruth 4:1.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe here is the most important word in prayer — God meets me in this place, not in some other one.
